title: Product factory and catalogue ownership
workflow: Open a draft product owned by one institution
Define family, supported currencies and permitted customer segments
Link applicable jurisdiction and regulatory authority evidence
Attach pricing, accounting and lifecycle policy candidates
invariants: Product definition does not itself create account or move funds
Product changes create versions rather than rewriting active customer contracts
Each product currency and institution combination is validated
Product approval cannot bypass unresolved PCEC mapping
Retired editions remain readable for historical calculation
Default product availability is disabled pending approvals
Product catalogue cannot assert a licensed offering without institution authorization
planned_tests: Draft product cannot open an account
Conflicting product code for same institution rejected
Prior contract remains pinned to prior terms
approval_gate: Licensed institution profile, product owner, regulatory eligibility, CFO mapping and acceptance reviewer.
